name: held-text-record-is-dormant
description: A word of a workflow comment, versions, is the name of a file of the program, so the held text holds that file and its exports. The directive on its test-only export is then neither in effect nor stale: a hold is a question the analysis leaves open, not evidence that the code changed, so the record is dormant, nothing is reported about the export and the run fails on no stale suppression.
